description: This file contains the implementation of a class 'jiradbInterface' that integrates with Jira's database. It extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for connecting to the database, retrieving issues, and managing statuses specific to Jira, including configuration handling.

classes.name: jiradbInterface
classes.description: A class providing an interface between the application and Jira's database, enabling issue retrieval and status management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, connects to Jira database, and sets up configuration and statuses.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Processes configuration to extract Jira version and validate it.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue by ID from Jira database.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP configuration detail.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves available statuses from Jira database and populates statusDomain mapping.

methods.name: getStatusDomain
methods.description: Provides the current status domain mapping.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of an issue ID.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template configuration XML snippet for Jira integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (returns false).
